entities.summary: Major-General Han Moo-hyup was a Korean army general, businessman, and high-level government official of South Korea. He was the Honorary Chairman of the Korea Esperanto-Asocio, formerly major general of the Republic of Korea Army, and CEO and owner of Hyundai Insurance. Park Chung Hee, former president of South Korea, officiated at Han's wedding as an old friend.
